section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedures for a Portuguese study examining emotional regulation processes and mental health. The initial sample consisted of 514 participants (494 women and 20 men) recruited through online social network advertisements, with ages ranging from 17 to 57 years. Data cleaning excluded male participants and female participants outside the 18-54 age range, though the final cleaned sample size is not specified in this excerpt.
